title: A pair list defines a perfect matching
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a type, let $V$ be a list of elements of $\alpha$, and let $E$ be a list of pairs in $\alpha$. Suppose the list formed by concatenating the two endpoints of every pair in $E$ is a permutation of $V$, that $V$ has no repetitions, and that every element of $\alpha$ belongs to $V$. If $G$ is a simple graph on $\alpha$ containing the graph generated by $E$ as a subgraph, then that generated graph, regarded as a subgraph of $G$, is a perfect matching.
